QuestInfo.name: Servant of the Devil Clan
QuestInfo.0: You encountered Yun Wu in the cavern. This time he won't get away!
QuestInfo.1: Yun Wu said that this time, he would finally be victorious over you. Although he became stronger with the demonic techniques, you didn't sit idly by! You vow to take your revenge for the Xuanshan School.
QuestInfo.2:
You finally defeated Yun Wu. 

He collapsed and started to laugh like a man possessed. He just wanted more power, to be strong enough to never be looked down on again... 

He considered strength and power to be his only virtues, and thus was greedier than any other. The master knew this about him, yet wanted to give Yun Wu his trust and his time. Finally understanding all the master had done for him, Yun Wu had remorse, yet he still met his end at the hands of the Devil Clan he had worked with.
